Hi,

Could you confirm when my Harlo B30 order Shop···· will ship? I was previously told October 30.

Thanks,
Ari

Hi Ari,

Your Harlo B30 on order Shop···· ships November 30, 2026. Sorry for the confusion. The October 30 date we gave you earlier has been replaced, and November 30 is the date on your order now. Your Harlo OS Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA is on the same order.

The order is paid and your B30 is set aside in our warehouse queue. The tracking link will go to this email address as soon as your miner ships. You can follow the batch on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hello HeliumDeploy team,

I am writing about my Harlo B30 order, Shop····, placed on September 24, 2026.

Power consumption and efficiency were important parts of my purchase decision. Since ordering, I have seen several materially different B30 power figures published across HeliumDeploy’s own pages. I would appreciate a clear, written specification for the unit that will fulfill my order.

Here is the progression I have documented:

Your July 14 article introduced the B30 as approximately 30 TH/s at 360–450 W, or about 12–15 J/TH:

https://heliumdeploy.com/blogs/mining-news/the-bsb-vision-why-we-built-the-b30

Your September 3 home-miner comparison again listed the B30 as 30 TH/s at 360–450 W measured at the wall and calculated its 12–15 J/TH efficiency from that range:

https://heliumdeploy.com/blogs/mining-news/top-5-home-bitcoin-miners-2026

On October 28, the Harlo collection page displayed approximately 485 W at the wall near the top while another section on the same page still described the B30 as running on roughly 400 W. The 485 W figure was above the original 360–450 W range and made the page internally inconsistent.

The currently published figures also vary:

The B30 product page lists approximately 30 TH/s and 360–450 W, with its FAQ saying about 400 W at the wall:
https://heliumdeploy.com/products/bsb-b30

The Harlo collection page lists approximately 30 TH/s at 405 W, while also describing it as roughly 400 W:
https://heliumdeploy.com/collections/harlo

Your miner-comparison page lists 30 TH/s, 405 W and 13.5 J/TH:
https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/which-miner-is-best

Your BM1373 history article says the B30 is expected to consume around 430 W at the wall:
https://heliumdeploy.com/blogs/mining-news/the-best-bm1373-bitcoin-home-miners

Before my order ships, please confirm the following in writing:

What wall power should I expect while the B30 is producing approximately 30 TH/s on 120 V US power?

Is 30 TH/s at no more than 450 W still the specification for my ordered unit?

Is the advertised 360 W lower end attainable on the shipping hardware, and if so, at what hashrate?

What explains the published 400 W, 405 W, 430 W, 450 W and 485 W figures?

Are all these figures measured AC wall consumption with the included power supply, or are any board-only estimates?

What operating tolerance should customers expect around the stated hashrate and wall-power figures?

Is my September order receiving the same hardware and power supply represented by the current product listing?

I understand that preliminary specifications can change during production. However, the B30’s efficiency and household electrical load were central to my purchase decision, and the published figures have changed enough that I need an unambiguous specification for my particular order.

If the shipping unit cannot reasonably deliver approximately 30 TH/s within the originally advertised 360–450 W wall-power range, please explain what options you are offering customers who ordered based on that representation, including cancellation and a full refund before shipment.

Thank you. I would appreciate a direct response addressing each question rather than another general estimate.

Ari
Order Shop····
Handed to the team · Spec figures conflict across our own pages and I can't confirm the shipping hard

Hi Ari,

Thank you for setting this out so clearly. You're right that our pages don't agree with each other. 360 to 450 W, 400 W, 405 W, 430 W and the 485 W you saw on October 28 can't all describe the same unit at 30 TH/s. You should get one figure you can rely on before your miner ships.

I won't guess at a spec for you. I've sent all seven of your questions to JD, who handles B30 hardware. That covers wall power at about 30 TH/s on 120 V, whether 30 TH/s at 450 W or less still holds, whether 360 W is reachable and at what hashrate, and where each published figure comes from. It also covers whether those figures are AC at the wall with the included supply, the tolerance to expect, and whether your September order gets the same hardware and power supply as the current listing. He'll answer each one in writing, including what your options are if the shipping unit doesn't meet the 360 to 450 W range.

The team comes online today at 10am ET, and his reply will come to this email address. Your order is paid and still ships November 30. Nothing about it changes while you wait for his answer.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hi Sarah,

Thank you for following up.

For the B30 already on order, direct shipment from China is fine provided that all duties, taxes, brokerage charges, and import fees are prepaid, there will be nothing due upon delivery, and the unit retains the same full HeliumDeploy warranty and support coverage. Please proceed and send me the tracking information once it ships.

Regarding the KBox, it repeatedly loses active chips and drops substantially below its normal hashrate. It can fall from all 18 chips and approximately 22 TH/s to as few as 14 chips with materially reduced performance. A software restart does not reliably restore it; it generally requires complete removal of power followed by a cold restart. That restores it temporarily, but the problem returns after several days. I have diagnostic reports and monitoring history documenting these failures.

Because this is a recurring failure and the previous warranty route did not work, I do not want the same unit repaired and returned again.

My preferred resolution is a prepaid return and full refund. I am also considering replacing the KBox with a second Harlo B30 if the first B30 performs well. If HeliumDeploy can offer the option of applying the KBox’s full refund or credit directly toward a second B30, please let me know the exact terms, including any price difference and confirmation that the second B30 would have the same warranty, prepaid duties and import fees, and current specifications:

Turbo: approximately 30 TH/s at 485 W

Balanced: approximately 24 TH/s at 350 W

Eco: approximately 18 TH/s at 230 W

Please send the prepaid KBox return label and written return instructions, along with the available refund and second-B30 replacement options. I will keep the American Express dispute open until we agree on the resolution and the refund or replacement has been fully completed.

Thank you for addressing this directly.

Thanks,

Ari
Handed to the team · KBOX order Shop···· has an open Amex dispute (ledger and processor case map),

Hi Ari,

Thanks for the clear go-ahead on the B30. I've passed your acceptance to the team. You asked for duties, taxes, brokerage and import fees to be prepaid so nothing is due on delivery, and for your full HeliumDeploy warranty and support to stay the same. Those are part of what I sent, and the team will confirm both in writing when they arrange the shipment from China. Tracking will come to this email address as soon as it leaves.

I'm sorry about the KBOX. Losing chips over and over, dropping from 18 to 14, and only coming back after a full power-off for a few days is exactly the kind of fault that should have been fixed the first time. I've passed on everything you described, including that you have diagnostic reports and monitoring history and don't want the same unit repaired and sent back. I also sent both outcomes you'd accept: a prepaid return with a full refund, or putting the KBOX value toward a second B30 at the 485 W, 350 W and 230 W specs you listed.

I can't set the return label or the exact terms from here, so I won't guess at them. A colleague picks this up today at 10am ET. You'll get the label, the return instructions and the exact refund or second-B30 terms by email. Those terms will include any price difference, the warranty and the prepaid duties.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hi Georges,

Thank you. I would like to choose option 2: the second Harlo B30 at no additional cost as the replacement for the defective KBox.

I will return the KBox, power supply, and included accessories using the prepaid UPS label and packing instructions. I will let you know once UPS has accepted the package.

After the KBox reaches your warehouse, please confirm the replacement B30 order in writing, including the $0 balance, full warranty, prepaid duties and import fees, and the expected shipping timeframe. Once the replacement arrangement is formally confirmed, I will coordinate withdrawal of the American Express dispute so there is no duplicate refund or credit.

Thank you for resolving this.

Best regards,

Ari A. when will the original one ship out to me?
Handed to the team · Open Amex dispute on Shop····, so I can't create the RMA replacement myself.

Hi Ari,

Thank you for choosing. I've noted option 2 on your KBOX: a second Harlo B30 at no additional cost to replace it. Please write Shop···· on the outside of the box as Georges described. You don't need to email us when UPS accepts it, because we can follow it on tracking ····. Once the KBOX reaches our warehouse, you'll get written confirmation of the replacement B30 order. It will cover the $0 balance, the warranty, the prepaid duties and import fees, and the shipping timeframe.

Your original B30 on Shop···· hasn't left yet, and there's no tracking number so far. It's still set to ship by November 30. I don't have the exact date it leaves China, so I've asked the team to confirm it. A colleague picks this up today at 10am ET, and the date will come to this email address. Tracking follows as soon as it ships.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hi Hal,

Thank you for confirming the second Harlo B30 at no additional cost.

The KBox still operates, but it requires restarting a couple of times each day. Because my original B30 is not expected until mid-December, returning the KBox now would leave a significant gap in my mining operation.

Would you please allow me to keep using the KBox until my original B30 on order Shop···· is delivered? Once that first B30 arrives, I will promptly pack the KBox with its power supply and accessories and return it using the prepaid UPS label and the provided RMA instructions.

I understand that this may mean the replacement B30 ships separately and later. That is acceptable to me. I am only trying to avoid losing the KBox’s remaining production while waiting for the original B30.

Please confirm in writing whether this return sequence is acceptable and whether I may use the existing prepaid UPS label at that time.

Best regards,

Ari
Handed to the team · Changes the return order the team agreed on, on an order with an open Amex dispu

Hi Ari,

Thanks for explaining. Keeping the KBOX running until your first B30 arrives makes sense if you don't want to lose that production.

The agreed plan is to send the KBOX back first and ship your second B30 after it reaches our warehouse. Changing that order, and whether the current UPS label will still work later, needs the team's sign-off, so I can't confirm either one myself. I've sent them your request as you wrote it. You'd keep using the KBOX until the first B30 is delivered, return it on the existing label with Shop···· on the box, and the second B30 would ship separately afterwards.

A colleague picks this up today at 10am ET, and the written answer will come to this email address. Your choice of the second B30 at no additional cost stays as agreed.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy
